hero.title: Precision in Every Frame. Craft in Every Cut.
hero.description: Video production company and studio fabrication team based in Lagos. We shoot documentaries, commercials, and podcasts, and build custom production sets.
hero.richTextHtml: PrimeLense Media shoots with cinema cameras (RED, Sony CineAlta, ARRI) using ACES color management for television, commercial, and streaming releases.
hero.ogTitle: PrimeLense Media | Video Production & Studio Fabrication
hero.ogDescription: Video production company delivering documentaries, commercials, podcasts, and custom studio builds.

company-profile.title: Company Profile
company-profile.description: Based in Lagos, Nigeria, PrimeLense Media produces video content and builds custom studios for businesses, television networks, and independent creators.
company-profile.richTextHtml: PrimeLense Media provides media production, multi-camera live coverage, podcast production, and custom studio fabrication.
company-profile.ogDescription: Learn about PrimeLense Media production capabilities and studio services.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide high-quality video production and studio fabrication that helps brands and creators tell their stories with technical clarity.
mission.richTextHtml: We deliver dependable camera crews, proper lighting, clean sound, and tailored studio sets that meet broadcast delivery standards.
mission.ogDescription: Our mission and production standards at PrimeLense Media.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.tagline: A Trusted Production Partner in Nigeria
vision.description: To be the most dependable production company and studio builder for broadcast television, corporate video, and podcast studios.
vision.richTextHtml: A production house recognized for straightforward client service, disciplined timelines, and technical consistency.
vision.ogDescription: Vision and future direction for PrimeLense Media.

who-we-serve.title: Who We Serve
who-we-serve.description: We work with corporate institutions, television broadcasters, advertising agencies, churches, NGOs, and independent creators.
who-we-serve.richTextHtml:
• Corporates & Financial Institutions: Executive interviews, investor videos, and annual meeting broadcasts.
  • Agencies & Brands: Commercial spots, product launch videos, and digital ad sets.
  • Broadcasters & Independent Producers: Documentaries, talk shows, and color grading.
  • Creators & Podcasters: Multi-cam podcast setups and studio recording spaces.
who-we-serve.ogDescription: Production and studio solutions for businesses, creators, and broadcasters.

services.title: Production Disciplines & Services
services.description: Media Production, Live Event Broadcasting, Podcast Production, Studio Design & Fabrication, Commercials, and Media Consultation.
services.richTextHtml: Each project is run by experienced crew members using industry software (DaVinci Resolve Studio, Pro Tools, Premiere Pro) and cinema-grade hardware.
services.ogDescription: Video production, studio fabrication, live broadcasting, and podcast setups.
